notes: Bye week focus: on an open Saturday you choose what the week is for. Self-scout (+5 edge next game), heal up (every injured player gets a week back, no pads), hit the road (+12 recruiting hours) or a development week (young players get reps, some take a step). Crunch-time field goals now depend on your kicker, and a miss is narrated. Last result card lists all your calls (half, fourth, crunch).
